headline: Global ETF Rotation Analysis: Energy and Emerging Markets Lead While Industrial Groups Shift Lower
market_regime: Divergent relative performance characterized by persistent leadership in Global Energy and accelerating relative strength across select Emerging Markets, contrasted by rotation out of Industrials and defense themes.
executive_summary: Relative strength is improving across Global Energy and Emerging Markets ex-China, while broad Industrials and Aerospace & Defense exhibit deteriorating momentum. Key themes include emerging leadership in Latin America and Brazil, persistent multi-horizon relative strength in energy sub-sectors, and significant intra-sector divergences across Technology, Health Care, and Communication Services.

Emerging markets ex-China (EMXC, emerging, 20-bar score change 60.71) aligns with regional strength in Latin America (ILF, emerging, 20-bar score change 48.75) and Brazil (EWZ, emerging, 20-bar score change 55.78).

Pair State Tension for RSP vs SPY: RSP has a confirmed trend state of WEAKENING (score 40.96, 5-bar score change -16.74) while maintaining a confirmed pair signal of PAIR_LEADING versus paired ticker SPY, though its raw pair signal is lagging (1/3 days) with 20-bar pair spread -1.68 percentage points and 63-bar pair spread -0.7 percentage points.
methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
